summary.text: Software Engineer with a First-Class Honors degree in Information Technology and strong expertise in backend systems, full-stack web development, and DevOps automation. Open-source contributor to the Rust ecosystem (deadpool-rs) and creator of multiple developer tools, including a AWS Firecracker MicroVM Rust code execution server, a Rust LLDB MCP server, a PostgreSQL cluster setup and management tool, and an automated VPS deployment CLI. Proficient across Rust, Go, TypeScript, Python, and Java (Spring Boot), with hands-on experience in PostgreSQL, Docker, Linux infrastructure, and cloud administration.

highlights.text: Open-Source (deadpool-rs): Merged PRs fixing DevContainer/Docker build caching (#477) and exporting QueueMode macro visibility (#478).
DevOps & Systems Tools: Built Rust and Go tools: TOML VPS deployer (crane), PostgreSQL supervisor (pgvisor), and Firecracker MicroVM Rust sandbox.
Full-Stack Apps: Built Rust, Go, and Spring Boot apps with background workers, Stripe payments, role-based dashboards, QR ordering, and PDF reports.
Technical Writing: Author of thedreambook.github.io, covering systems programming, backend design, and DevOps.
Performed manual and automated QA testing for a government web system using a Java/Selenium framework.
Logged defects, tracked test coverage, and worked with engineers to meet government specifications.
Built a full-stack web module with JSF, PrimeFaces, and PostgreSQL under senior engineer mentorship.
Automated bulk staff directory updates using Google Forms surveys and a Python HTML generator script.
Redesigned the university WordPress portal to modernize UI and improve navigation.
Provided hardware, network, and software support for faculty workstations and events.
